notes.title: V1.0.41 - QoL and Bugs
notes.content:
Other players mouse-over stocks sort alphabetically
 Fixed bug - Random starting stock wasn't animating correctly.
 Fixed bug - Refactored preference to join friends games over PUGs


Stay cool.

notes.title: V1.0.4 - QoL and Minor Features
notes.content:
Made how to buy/sell stocks a little more clear (hopefully)
 Changed roll time to be between 1 and 3 seconds, down from 1 to 5.
 Added game rule to clamp total roll time at 1.5 seconds
 Added game rule to randomize stock starting values
 Added settings button in game scene (escape key still works in any scene)
 Added mute roll checkbox to settings
 Squashed bug where finding games would hang under some conditions


Stay cool.

notes.title: V1.0.3 - Minor additions and a change
notes.content:
Changed so only chimes on local players roll turn start
 Players can donate money to other players
 Added another silly achievement


I decided to add a donation mechanic because buddy sold everything and bought 147 silver stocks when they were super devalued. 5 turns later they bust
Guy sits and waits for 20 turns with $33 and no stocks. Yeeesh.

More to come. Report bugs as you interact with them.
Stay cool.

notes.title: V1.0.2 - Minor QoL additions
notes.content:
Chimes when someone emotes
 Hit spacebar is roll
 Stock Bust makes a sad sound
 Chime when its your turn
 Can only buy stocks you can afford
 - 1, 2, 3, etc to 0 on Keypad to set slider to 1, 2, 3, etc to 10


More to come. Report bugs as you interact with them.
